Subject: Mutual action plan: closure cadence, paperwork & signature slots

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for a productive eval last week. I attached the updated mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_v7.xlsx) and a redline of the SOW we discussed (SOW-draft.pdf). Key asks from StellarData we captured: audit logs retention, private deployment options for EU data, and the SLA exceptions for dedicated pools.

Proposed final cadence:
- 2027-04-29: internal approvals + legal review complete
- 2027-05-03: signatures via DocuSign (we can open slots on 05/03 and 05/04)
- 2027-05-10: target start date (pilot capacity live)

Could you confirm whether 05/03 signature slots work for your team and if contracts@stellardata can be looped for the SOW review? If you prefer, I can lock a 30-minute signature coordination call and share the DocuSign template.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v7.xlsx (MAP), SOW-draft.pdf (SOW, redline)

Thanks,

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the MAP and SOW. I shared both with our procurement and legal—contracts@stellardata is on copy. Procurement asked for two small clarifications in the SOW (section 4.2 and 7.1) around data residency wording; legal will send inline comments by EOD 04/28.

Signature availability: tentative OK for 05/03. I need to confirm with our CFO; can we provision two adjacent 30-minute DocuSign slots (morning PT preferred)? If legal has comments, we'll flag them in the DocuSign workflow so we don't block the date.

Appreciate you coordinating the start date—05/10 looks good from a project plan perspective but I will confirm once we have the final SOW.

Best,

Elena —

Quick internal update before you hear back from legal: Marissa (VP, Sales) has approved the commercial terms and Grace (Customer Success lead) has confirmed onboarding resource availability for a 05/10 start. We added a short signoff checklist (MAP-Signoff-Checklist.docx) that outlines approvers, required deliverables (SOC 2 artifact, IP addendum), and the DocuSign routing order.

If legal sends inline edits, we can accept non-material wording tweaks without moving the signature date as long as contracts@stellardata signs off on the final text by 05/02 EOD. Otherwise, we can push signatures to 05/04 morning.

I'll tentatively reserve two morning slots on DocuSign for 05/03 and 05/04 and share the link once you confirm the CFO availability.

Thanks — Naomi
